sources: The company's G&A costs rose $3.4M to $8.1M in H1 FY25, with $2.2M driven by M&A legal work — a signal that integration is resource-intensive and ongoing.
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage. Bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design.
2. One dominant flat block-colour background for the whole shot: deep magenta. Never a rainbow, never a gradient.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Never a recognisable person's face.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the background's contrasting colour. Real paper texture, print dots, small tape pieces.
5. Consistent upper-left light. Small paper-layer shadows only.
6. Everything is flat matte printed paper. No glow, no neon, no bloom, no halos, no luminous edges. Nothing emits light. Not glossy 3D. Not live action.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif, black or cream, printed on paper chips, large, safe margins. English spelling and letterforms accurate and stable. Only the headline text in the copy list, nothing else.
8. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window. One strongest visual focus at a time. No camera shake. Movement starts on the first frame; a small loop continues at the end. No empty frames.
9. Numbers, when specified, are printed complete from their first visible frame. Never counting up, never morphing, never redrawn.
10. No brands, logos, watermarks, or text beyond the copy list.
11. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
12. Identity anchor: rough white torn-paper edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: deep magenta.
Subjects: the four buildings; a rising paper bar.
Opens on the four buildings, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The buildings compress into one rising paper bar that climbs and locks in place.
Ends holding on the rising bar.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "$8.1M G&A".

COPY LIST: "$8.1M G&A". Exact strings; nothing else appears in frame.

AUDIO: No voice, no speech, no dialogue, no lyrics. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects only; no music.
expandedPrompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic 2D-animated modern editorial paper collage. The scene opens on a flat, matte, deep magenta background. The composition features four distinct black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts of architectural buildings, each featuring rough white torn-paper edges and a subtle drop shadow cast to the bottom-right from a consistent upper-left light source. On the first frame, these four building cutouts rapidly compress and merge downward through a snappy motion design transition, instantly transforming into a single, vertical cream-colored matte paper bar. This paper bar slides upward with fast speed, featuring a slight overshoot before locking firmly into a stable vertical position. Simultaneously, a rectangular paper chip in a contrasting cream color slides into the upper portion of the frame, bearing the headline text "$8.1M G&A" in a clean, extra-bold black sans-serif typeface. The text is printed clearly and legibly with no misspellings. The final two seconds hold this composition, with the paper bar and the text chip remaining static, though a very subtle, slow-pulsing scale loop is applied to the bar to maintain visual energy. All elements maintain a flat, non-glossy print texture with visible halftone dots and no luminous effects.

overall_soundscape: A series of crisp, tactile foley sounds: a quick, rhythmic paper-slap occurs as the buildings compress, followed by a sharp, sticky sound of adhesive tape being pressed down as the bar locks into place. The soundscape is minimalist, consisting only of these physical paper manipulations against a silent background.
